turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Great. Quick rule: he/she/it + verb + -s (she works). Some verbs take -es, like teach -> teaches, and consonant + y becomes -ies, like study -> studies.

First exercise: He ___ (drink) tea in the morning. Write only the verb.

W2 (wrong) strength 1: -s goes on every verb and -es/-ies are not needed. Its error: adds -s wrongly or misspells -es/-ies ("She watchs TV", "I plays").
